name: Fed rate cuts in the rest of 2026
description: 5 remaining FOMC meetings (Jun 17, Jul 29, Sep 16, Oct 28, Dec 9). Current target midpoint 3.625% (range 3.50-3.75%). Each meeting cuts 25bps with an uncertain per-meeting probability (triangular 10/25/45% — an estimate, the key tunable assumption). Reports the distribution of total cuts and the year-end rate.

context.decision: How many 25bps cuts will the Fed make in the rest of 2026, and where does the rate land?
context.assumptions: Per-meeting cut probability triangular(0.10, 0.25, 0.45) — an estimate; refine from CME FedWatch.
